#### Two cut cables

The cables $\set{b, d}$ and $\set{c, e}$ of the office (@exr-office-cables) are cut.
@fig-office-cut draws the graph $H$ of the cables that are left.
Is there still a walk (@def-walk) from $a$ to $f$ in $H$?

::: {#fig-office-cut}

The graph $H$: the office graph without the edges $\set{b, d}$ and $\set{c, e}$.
